newsitem.title: INDIA: Bajaj Auto 96/7 net slightly higher-paper.
newsitem.headline: Bajaj Auto 96/7 net slightly higher-paper.

text.p: Bajaj Auto's net profit in 1996/97 (April-March) will be between 4.25-4.30 billion rupees according to company sources, the Financial Express newspaper reported on Wednesday.
The company posted a profit after tax of 4.18 billion rupees in 1995/96.
The report said Bajaj Auto sold 1.43 million vehicles as sales in the second half slowed, but the total was still 10 percent higher than the previous year's 1.3 million.
Turnover was projected at 34.0 billion rupees, up 16 percent from 29.32 billion rupees in 1995/96.
The company's board is scheduled to meet on May 14 to settle the 1996/97 financial results and decide the dividend.
